scientific_integrity: Proof of the exact rank is self-contained after standard hyperelliptic Cartier and tame-involution facts. Finite verification is supplementary. Prior maximality and automorphism theorems are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Only odd n>5 and p>3 with p² congruent -1 modulo 2n.
Exact first Cartier rank and a-number, not the full Ekedahl–Oort type.
Maximality and automorphism group are prior work.
Historical priority not independently adjudicated; one related full article not inspected.
title: Half-rank Cartier operators on maximal Dickson hyperelliptic curves
